title: RET-enhanced measurement of relaxation time constants of LOV2-based optogenetic actuators
protocol: Prepare plasmids for the experiment.
Culture HEK293 cells in a 10cm dish with DMEM-high glucose medium supplemented with 10% FBS, 2mM Glutamine, and 50unit-50µg/ml Penicillin-Streptomycin at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Prewarm culture medium in a 37°C water bath. Thaw the 2.5% trypsin stock in room temperature.
Aspirate culture medium from the 10cm dish containing HEK293 cells. Gently rinse cells with about 2-3ml Versene once.
Add 1ml of Versene containing final 0.05% trypsin to the cells. Rock the plate gently and leave in the cell culture incubator for 5 min.
When fully detached, add 1ml of warm culture medium to the dish. Pipette up and down until all the cells are dissociated. Transfer to a 50ml conical tube and centrifuge at 800rpm for 4 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in fresh culture medium gently.
Count the cells using a Bürker chamber.
Plate 400,000 cells with 2ml of medium into one 35mm dish.
Prepare an additional dish for untransfection control based on the number of plasmids needed.
Transfect cells using Calcium-phosphate precipitation the day after plating.
Mix 2.5 µg of plasmid DNA with 6.25 µl of 2.5M CaCl₂ and add 62.5 µl of 2XHebs stock to each transfection mix.
Drop the DNA-CaCl₂ mixture into 2XHeBs while swirling, wait for 30 minutes, then distribute evenly over cultures.
Leave transfected cells in the incubator for 48 hours.
Cool down 1x PBS and LSB solution with protease inhibitors on ice before use.
Aspirate cell culture medium from the dish and rinse the cell layer twice with cold PBS without disturbing it.
Add prepared LSB solution to the dish for lysis.
Pre-cool the benchtop centrifuge to 4 °C.
Centrifuge all cell lysates pre-clearing at 4 °C, at 20,000g for 10 min.
Transfer the supernatant of the centrifuged lysate into a new microfuge tube after centrifugation.
Aliquot the supernatant to smaller volumes and snap freeze all tubes in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw cell lysates on ice and cover tubes with foil.
Re-centrifuge cell lysate at 4 °C, 20,000g for 10 min after thawing.
Turn on the plate reader to ready it for measurement.
Transfer 20 μl of cell lysate to a half-area 96 well plate.
Add 5 μl mineral oil on top of the cell lysate to prevent evaporation.
Equilibrate the plate at either 25°C or 37°C in the plate reader for 5-10 min before measurement.
